$comment: Which CI jobs a pull request runs (CI-002, ADR-0043), read by tools/cmd/affected.
Globs are anchored at the repository root; ** matches any number of directories; a leading ! excludes.
go and goTest name Go packages (dir or dir/...): their in-repository imports are followed, goTest with their tests' imports.
dart names Dart packages: their pub workspace dependencies are followed, without the dependencies' tests, examples and Markdown.
exclude removes files from all of a job's roots. make lists what `make check-changed` runs for the job.

everything: a change runs every job. noJob: files no selectable job reads (documentation, local scripts, the nightly load test, inputs of the always-on checks); alone they run only the always-on jobs.
A changed file in neither list nor any job's roots runs every job. Pushes to main, the merge queue, the daily run and manual runs run every job.

go-lint.description: Format, lint and tidiness of both Go modules, and `make gen` reproducing everything it writes (CI-003) from schema/, proto/ and the licence texts

api-contract.description: buf lint, format and breaking-change check of the API contract

go-test.description: Go tests of both modules with the race detector and coverage floors; tests also read schema/, the generated Dart and TypeScript, the benchmark's baseline, and (the policy tests) the workflows, manifests, packages' READMEs, changelogs and examples, and the specification

go-determinism.description: The compiler reproduces the committed goldens byte for byte on Linux, macOS and Windows (CMP-002)

go-vuln.description: govulncheck over the code both modules build; the daily run catches newly published vulnerabilities

compose.description: The server image and the Compose stack, with the integration tests against PostgreSQL, SeaweedFS and Valkey

image-arm64.description: The server image built natively on arm64, its SVG compiler reproducing the amd64 golden

wasm-codecs.description: The WebAssembly image codecs rebuilt from their pinned sources; it takes minutes, so pushes to main skip it

dart.description: Format, analysis and tests with coverage floors of every Dart package; the tests read the shared vectors in schema/

starter-e2e.description: The starter app's and the add-to-app module's flows under flutter test against a server built from source, and the compatibility matrix

e2e-android.description: The starter app's flows and the Kotlin add-to-app host's on the Android 35 emulator

e2e-android-26.description: The Android 26 emulator: on pushes to main, the daily and manual runs, and pull requests that change Android-specific files or dependencies (maintainer, 2026-10-01)

e2e-ios.description: The starter app's flows and the Swift add-to-app host's on the newest iOS simulator under XCTest: on pull requests for the runtime, the starter app and their dependencies, iOS-specific files and the flows' fixture, not for server-only changes, which the Android 35 job runs on a device (maintainer, 2026-10-01)

bench-runtime.description: The runtime benchmark against the base's runtime (QA-007)

bench-sync.description: The sync benchmark on the simulated slow network against a server built from source (QA-007, NFR-007)

size-android.description: What plux_flutter adds to the release APKs and App Bundle downloads (RT-061)

size-ios.description: What plux_flutter adds to a release iOS app (RT-061)

studio.description: Studio: frozen install, Biome, types, tests with coverage floors
